# JasperLAX.com

> JasperLAX provides comfortable, economical private Toyota Sienna transfers to and from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), for parties of up to 6 passengers. Service covers Los Angeles, Orange, San Bernardino, Riverside and Ventura counties in Southern California. Published regional starting fares are per vehicle; parking and highway tolls are included. Final availability, luggage fit and the trip quote are confirmed before booking.

Website: https://jasperlax.com/
Business location: San Marino, California, United States.
Content reviewed: October 15, 2026. Amounts below are in US dollars (USD).

**Who we are.** JasperLAX.com focuses on comfortable, economical private Toyota Sienna airport transfers to and from Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) in Southern California. The service is intended for families, small groups and individual travelers who want a vehicle reserved for their own booking party.

**Core service.** Private airport pickups from LAX and airport drop-offs at LAX, in either direction between the airport and an address in the service area. Customers can request transfers involving a home, hotel, office or event venue. The vehicle is arranged for the booking party; starting fares are vehicle prices rather than individual passenger ticket prices. Exact addresses and the complete itinerary are needed to confirm service availability and the final quote.

**Vehicle and group planning.** JasperLAX focuses on the Toyota Sienna. Published capacity is up to 6 passengers and at least 4 pieces of luggage. Passenger capacity alone does not establish luggage fit: suitcase dimensions, carry-ons, strollers, child seats and seating configuration must be checked for the actual group before booking. Gallery images are illustrative and Toyota reference photos; vehicle year, color and trim may vary. Groups exceeding this capacity should contact the team about alternatives before booking; a larger vehicle is not included in the published Sienna starting fares.

**Service area.** The five counties are Los Angeles County, Orange County, San Bernardino County, Riverside County and Ventura County. Dedicated city information is available for Irvine, Anaheim and Pasadena. Other destinations require a service-availability inquiry. A county being listed does not mean every address has the same fare or that a vehicle is guaranteed to be available.

**Published starting fares.** Los Angeles to/from LAX: from $99 per vehicle. Orange County to/from LAX: from $119 per vehicle. San Bernardino and Riverside to/from LAX: from $129 per vehicle. Ventura County requires a quote. No separate fixed starting fare is published for Irvine, Anaheim or Pasadena. These are starting prices, not a guaranteed final price for every address, date, itinerary or optional service.

**What is included and what costs extra.** The quoted vehicle price includes parking and highway tolls. Gratuity is not included. Meet & Greet with a name sign is an additional $30. A child seat costs $35, subject to availability and suitability; customers should provide the child's age, height and weight when requesting one. Additional stops are priced according to the extra distance and time. Review all charges in the final quote before completing a reservation.

**Practical advantages.** A dedicated private Sienna can serve a family or small group together. Per-vehicle starting prices help the party plan its transportation budget. Including parking and highway tolls makes the base vehicle-price inclusions clear. Flight monitoring, agreed meeting instructions and optional buffer time help coordinate airport arrivals. Curbside Pickup and optional Meet & Greet offer different meeting arrangements. Text, WhatsApp and LINE provide ways to ask about the trip or get reservation assistance.

**Problems the service helps customers plan for.**
- A family traveling with suitcases, a stroller or children: check the actual luggage and seating arrangement, and request an appropriate child seat before reserving.
- An unfamiliar LAX arrival: agree on Curbside Pickup or paid Meet & Greet and follow the chauffeur's instructions and current airport signs for the meeting location.
- Immigration or baggage-collection uncertainty: arrange buffer time when booking instead of assuming the chauffeur will wait at the airport from landing throughout that buffer.
- A delayed flight: the chauffeur monitors the flight and adjusts arrival pickup timing to its actual arrival.
- A flight departure or a business meeting: share the required arrival time, exact entrance and intermediate stops so the complete itinerary can be discussed. Driving time depends on traffic and the destination; no fixed journey-time guarantee is published.
- A group comparing airport transfer costs: request the total vehicle quote, check optional-service charges and confirm luggage fit rather than treating the starting price as a per-person price.
- An existing booking that is difficult to find: use the confirmation link or sign in to Moovs with the reservation contact details; customer support can also help.

**Airport waiting and buffer time.** Without agreed buffer time, complimentary waiting starts at actual flight landing: 30 minutes for domestic arrivals and 60 minutes for international arrivals. Agreed buffer time delays the chauffeur's airport arrival; the chauffeur will not be on airport standby before that buffer ends, and complimentary waiting then begins after the buffer. For example, a domestic arrival with an agreed 30-minute buffer has the chauffeur arrive 30 minutes after actual landing, followed by the 30-minute complimentary waiting period. Additional waiting after the applicable buffer and complimentary period costs $15 per 15 minutes.

**Finding the chauffeur at LAX.** Curbside Pickup and Meet & Greet are different arrangements; confirm which is reserved before travel. For curbside pickup, collect your bags and coordinate the terminal, level and pickup-column number with the chauffeur. For Meet & Greet, follow the arranged arrivals-hall meeting instructions. Any column numbers shown in website diagrams are examples, not a fixed meeting point for every flight. Follow the chauffeur's instructions and current airport signs.

**Departures and other one-way pickups.** The chauffeur is scheduled to arrive 15 minutes before the reserved pickup time. Complimentary waiting is 15 minutes from the scheduled pickup time. Additional waiting costs $15 per 15 minutes. For LAX drop-offs, provide the departure airline and flight details and allow time for traffic, airline check-in and security. Extra stops should be included in the quote request.

**Cancellation and refunds.** Cancel more than 48 hours before scheduled pickup for a full refund with no cancellation fee. Cancellation from 48 hours to 24 hours before pickup incurs a 50% charge, with the remaining 50% refunded. Cancellation less than 24 hours before pickup is non-refundable. Refunds take up to 7 days depending on the payment channel. Cancellation requests and changes should be coordinated using the reservation details and the company's contact channels.

**Booking and flight details.** Moovs provides the booking form and customer portal. For a single airport transfer, select One Way and Airport Pick Up or Airport Drop Off. Where the complete portal presents Address/Airport switches, select Airport under Pick-up for arrivals or Drop-off for departures, then supply the airport, airline and flight number. If Hourly is selected for a single transfer, switch to One Way. A quote request alone does not confirm a reservation. Review the final quote, confirmation and meeting instructions before travel. Availability and the exact fields or steps depend on the live Moovs booking flow.

**Details needed for a quote.** Travel date and pickup time; exact pickup and drop-off addresses; hotel, building or venue name and meeting entrance; flight number for airport travel; passenger count; suitcase quantities and dimensions; stroller and child-seat requirements; requested buffer time; intermediate stops; and any required arrival time.

**Contact.** Text: +1 (626) 704-2786. WhatsApp: https://wa.me/16267042786 . LINE: https://line.me/ti/p/KE2kEevLtY . Use these channels for route inquiries, vehicle/luggage suitability, a trip quote or help with an existing reservation.

**Reviews and attribution.** The website presents selected Google reviews of Jasper Limousine Service in their original English. Some describe SUV and Sprinter trips rather than JasperLAX's Toyota Sienna service. They are attributed customer experiences, not a live feed or a separate aggregate rating for this Sienna product.

**Languages and source details.** The website has English, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Japanese and Korean pages. Website translations do not establish a chauffeur's spoken languages; discuss any language requirement with the team before booking. This file summarizes public service information; the linked service pages, the customer's final quote and reservation confirmation provide the details relevant to the actual trip. Flight details, contact information and reservation identifiers should be supplied through the booking form or customer-support channels, not posted publicly.
